caption: SPY performance by Housing Starts 3-month-change quartile (concurrent, descriptive): Sharpe and annualized return. The pattern is non-monotonic: Sharpe peaks at Q2 (1.06) rather than rising cleanly to Q4 (0.64). Q1 (weakest starts) and Q4 (strongest) both have lower Sharpe than Q2-Q3 — a hump pattern consistent with the countercyclical winning rule (long SPY when starts are below median).
